ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Oct-12-2006 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, VJ. Ollie Marie-Victoire, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Nici Rodich.
Petitioner: Angela Catherine Lintini, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Alissa Giavanna Wood, was sworn and examined.
Proof of Service of OSC for Change of Name of a Minor, served on the Minor's Father: John E. Wood, received and filed in court.
No objections to the proposed change of name of a minor were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Alissa Giavanna Lintini.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
